note: Manual, line-by-line spot-checks of the published dataset against the official source URLs, performed with an independent network path from the build runner. Each row states the exact URL opened, what was compared and the outcome. A row marked 'corrected' means the published data was wrong and was changed; 'unverified' means it could not be confirmed and is published as unverified.

checks.subject: Pinnacle duplicate series listings
checks.checked: One response contains moneyline markets for both matchupId 1638748200 ('Gen.G' vs 'Invictus') and 1638758865 ('Gen.G (Kills)' vs 'Invictus (Kills)').
checks.detail: The published snapshot priced the (Kills) derivative as the series moneyline for six of eight Worlds picks. Both collect.py and model.py now exclude any participant containing '(Kills)'; 8 derivatives were dropped and the 9 remaining market picks use true series moneylines.

checks.subject: Pinnacle Gen.G vs Invictus Gaming series line

checks.detail: Same market and side order; the live price at 15:50Z was -355 / +274, i.e. a normal line move during the four hours since the snapshot. Prices are therefore stored with the snapshot timestamp and never presented as live.
